title: Gatewell Protocol for Origin Evidence, Version 1.0, Annex B: bill-of-materials origin schema
description: Generated from the text of Annex B (1.0 (draft), Revision 3, September 17, 2026). The Protocol text governs. Schema dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

oef_revision.description: Revision identifier of the Origin Evidence File these records belong to (Annex G).

bom_line.title: B.1 BOM line

model_id.description: Manufacturer model number of the finished device. Rule: Must appear in the §4.1 schedule

item_ref.description: BOM line reference / internal part number. Rule: Unique within model

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number of the component. Rule: As marked or documented

component_mfr.description: Component manufacturer legal name. Rule: Not the distributor

mfr_country.description: Component manufacturer HQ country. Rule: ISO 3166 alpha-2

coo.description: Country of origin of the component as supplied. Rule: ISO 3166 alpha-2; "MULTI" prohibited — split lines

design_origin.description: Country where the component was designed. Rule: ISO 3166 alpha-2; required for deep-trace lines; "UNKNOWN" only with a documented inquiry record

supply_channel.description: Direct / distributor / broker. Rule: Broker-sourced deep-trace components require Annex C declaration regardless of tier

sole_source.description: Y if no alternate supplier is qualified at the revision date. Rule: Y requires a B.3 register entry

deep_trace.description: Y if the component matches Annex D for the category. Rule: Y requires declaration_ref

declaration_ref.description: Identifier of the Annex C declaration on file. Rule: Required when deep_trace = Y

verified_date.description: Date origin was last confirmed. Rule: Within 12 months of revision date for deep-trace lines

bom_line.description: Passive components (resistors, capacitors, standard connectors, fasteners, enclosures) may be aggregated by commodity class with a single coo entry per class where no Annex D match exists.

model_id.description: Finished device model. Rule: Must appear in the §4.1 schedule

country.description: Country of origin. Rule: ISO 3166 alpha-2; every coo in B.1 must appear

pct_value.description: Percentage of total BOM value originating in the country. Rule: Column sums to 100 ± 0.5 rounding

pct_volume.description: Percentage of component production volume (unit count) originating in the country. Rule: Column sums to 100 ± 0.5 rounding

basis_note.description: Valuation basis (standard cost or actual purchase cost) and the 12-month period used. Rule: Basis held consistent revision over revision; changes documented

computed_date.description: Date of computation. Rule: Equal to or later than the BOM revision it summarizes

model_id.description: The B.1 line concerned. Rule: Every B.1 line with sole_source = Y appears here

item_ref.description: The B.1 line concerned. Rule: Every B.1 line with sole_source = Y appears here

mpn.description: The B.1 line concerned. Rule: Every B.1 line with sole_source = Y appears here

contingency_ref.description: Document ID of the contingency plan. Rule: Plan must state the course of action if the supplier becomes unavailable: qualified alternate and qualification lead time, buffer-stock policy, or redesign path

last_reviewed.description: Date the plan was last reviewed. Rule: At each revision, and on any Part VI trigger affecting the supplier
